newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil March 8-April 7 Fipe inflation at 0.34 pct.
newsitem.headline: Brazil March 8-April 7 Fipe inflation at 0.34 pct.

text.p: Brazil's inflation as measured by the Economic Research Institute (Fipe) rose to 0.34 percent between March 8 and April 7, up from 0.21 percent in the previous four-week period, a Fipe official said.
The president of the Fipe institute, Juarez Rizzieri, said he expects inflation for the whole month of April to be slightly above 0.5 percent.
He also said that recent telephone and electricity rate hikes will not weigh on April inflation, but will have an impact on the Fipe index in May, June and July.
He noted that those rate increases will not affect Fipe's projections of a 7.0 percent annual inflation.
Rizzieri released the following breakdown of Fipe's weighted inflation index for March 8 and April 7:
- Food: 1.19 pct rise in the period
- Housing: 0.53 pct rise in the period
- Transportation: -0.23 pct drop in the period
- Personal expenses: -0.20 pct drop in the period
- Clothing: -1.47 pct drop in the period
- Health care: 0.27 pct rise in the month
- Education: 0.19 pct rise in the period
The Fipe index is calculated by the University of Sao Paulo, which releases inflation figures weekly.
